en: A black-and-white photograph of a modernist building occupying a street corner. The structure has a grid of large glass windows and prominent horizontal lines, typical of the International Style of architecture. On the building, the letters 'PDT' are visible. There are pedestrians walking in front of the building, and the surroundings include paved streets and some older residential buildings in the background. There is a small printed mark in the lower right corner, possibly an attribution or signature.
